answer: One concrete defense makes established standing a costly, time-bound signal rather than a one-time stake. Each identity must accrue graded, non-replayable work receipts across many real epochs before it carries a jury seat, so the honest lattice grows like a trellis: slow and load-bearing. A sybil swarm mints keys cheaply but cannot fake the timber of accumulated peer-attested grading labor. Forging one epoch is easy; forging fifty distinct ones under rotating co-sit partners is not. Cost scales with the fake identities, never the honest ones.
